name: duel_breach
description: 0.9.0's sends that bite (release page, Undertow): a duel on Undertow's own rules, me a Lamplighter defending with her plan, a caretaker Lamplighter the rival. In window 2 I cork the Moth Cloud (fliers, which the Lamplighter is weak to) with a click on the Drift tray, say Ready, and uncork it with Space once I may; nothing else is staged. My four Duskmoths fly the rival's road among its own wave 2; the camera on the rival's hollow (V), then framed on its Holdfast (left of it and nearer, 9 units out), the moment the first of them has reached it: the other three, each carrying its bottle, at the Holdfast, and the duel bar counting my breach. The picture is the Holdfast with the duel bar above it.

steps.msg: a duel on the real preset: me on the first hollow, a caretaker rival on the second
the Moth Cloud is on offer and I can pay for it
my Moth Cloud broke through, seen on the rival's hollow
the rival's Holdfast framed, my other three Duskmoths at it
